sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:38

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:38:1
items.html: Mochin for his Nukva pierce the screen and the vessels of ZA through his back, etc., and then their strength is greatly weakened: This refers to the Mochin of Katnut for the Nukva, for these Mochin he gives to the Nukva during her Katnut, until she becomes grown and is sawn off from him, as is explained in its place. Therefore, the Gevurot do not come from a coupling of HB of her own, but rather she receives them through the posterior of the Chazeh of ZA, as is explained in its place, and therefore they are greatly weakened, and do not shine.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:38:2
items.html: And He bored one hole in the posterior of the body of ZA, opposite the Chazeh: This will be explained below.
